rationale: Design taken from the methods section of Pinto-Fernandez et al., Br J Cancer 124:817-830 (2021), doi:10.1038/s41416-020-01167-y. Methods state HAP1 (CML-derived) wild-type and HAP1 USP18-/- CRISPR knockout cells, treated with human IFN-alpha2b at 1000 U/mL, with the GlyGly peptidome comparison performed at 48 h. GlyGly peptides were enriched by immunoaffinity purification using the PTMScan Ubiquitin Remnant Motif kit and analysed on a Q Exactive HF; searches were run in MaxQuant v1.5.5.1 against UniProtKB human with LFQ quantitation. Column names in the site table encode genotype (WT / KO), treatment (presence or absence of the _IFN token) and replicate index (1-3) unambiguously, so the mapping from column to condition is direct. One column, 'KO_1_181212063719', carries a trailing instrument run identifier which was stripped to recover the sample name; this is a naming inconsistency in the deposit, not a distinct condition. No SDRF-Proteomics file accompanies the deposit, which is expected for a 2020 submission, so this mapping is an inference from the publication rather than an authoritative statement from the submitters — hence confidence 'inferred' rather than 'authoritative'. Quantitative values used are the 'Ratio mod/base' columns, which divide modified-peptide intensity by the unmodified protein signal and therefore measure stoichiometry natively; the raw 'Intensity' columns are confounded by interferon-driven induction of the parent proteins and should not be used for this contrast.
unresolved: Timepoint for the unstimulated (non-IFN) arms is not stated separately in the methods; timepoint_h is therefore recorded only for the IFN arms and left absent elsewhere rather than assumed to be 48 h.

Replicate type (biological vs technical) is not explicitly stated in the methods for the GlyGly peptidome. Recorded as 'unspecified' pending author correspondence. This affects how the variance estimate in any differential test should be interpreted.
Whether a matched wild-type-only site table exists as a separate file in the deposit, or whether this single table contains all twelve samples. The column names indicate the latter.

project.title and experiment.title are not supplied. Both are identifying (ONTOLOGY.md §3), so no Experiment id and therefore no Sample id can be constructed until the curator provides them. The loader must refuse rather than derive a title from the accession — inventing one is forbidden (CLAUDE.md: real external identifiers only).

experiment.organism_taxid is stated at experiment level rather than derived from the mapping, because it is identifying on Experiment (ONTOLOGY.md §3). Consequence: one organism per Experiment, so cross-species work is two Experiments, not one with mixed samples.

Each mapping entry needs source_type ('cell_line' | 'tumour_tissue' | 'primary_cell'). It is identifying on Sample and is NOT a determined absence, so a Sample cannot be keyed without it. model_system stays absent for a cell line — that absence IS determined by source_type (§3).

contrasts_of_interest.note: Primary contrast. Corresponds to Figure 2f of the publication.
Negative control. Publication reports no significant change, consistent with USP18 being expressed at very low levels when the IFN pathway is inactive.

Ratio mod/base KO_1_181212063719.note: Trailing token 181212063719 is an instrument run identifier, not a condition.

corrections.supersedes: the quantity preference stated in `rationale`, which is retained above unedited
corrections.note: The rationale prefers the 'Ratio mod/base' columns and states the raw 'Intensity' columns should not be used for this contrast. Measurement contradicts that preference. Ratio mod/base yields only 23 testable sites of 2,056 — stoichiometrically correct but unusable at this modification's occupancy — while Intensity with Perseus-style imputation yields thousands and recovers 12 of the 14 published targets (ROADMAP.md, Measured findings, 2026-08-06). The analysis actually run is recorded in analysis_PXD018299_KOIFN_vs_WTIFN.json with quantity 'intensity_multiplicity_summed'. The reasoning behind the original preference was sound — Intensity IS confounded by interferon-driven induction of the parent proteins — and that confound is now carried as protein_adjusted='not_applied', labelled stoichiometry-uncorrected wherever the result appears (I4), rather than by discarding the quantity. The mapping keys below still name the Ratio columns and are left untouched: they record which columns this curation was written against.
